title: Michael G
content: My parents were taking us to a friend’s house for the 4th of July weekend. There were several other kids, but I was the only one who couldn’t swim. All of us jumped into the pool. Although the pool was only four feet deep, I went under the water. I don’t remember going under. What I do remember is flying through a tunnel made of swirling blue and silver beams. I was moving toward a very bright, white light. Yet, I did not feel like I was moving. I went into the light. The next thing I saw was a very large tree on a hill. The tree was surrounded by a valley with other hills and within walking distance. There were white houses with no features on them; they were standing in clusters of three on each hillside. In the valley, between the hills and surrounding the hill with the tree, were flowers everywhere. Each flower was either purple, blue, yellow, or orange. A creek ran down one side with a small stone, walking bridge crossing it. Above the bridge was a permanent sunset, giving the air a golden hue and filling everything with a strange, warm, and loving feeling. The next thing I knew, a group of kids and some young adults ran up to show me their spot under the tree. It had a campfire and a few stools. The walk up felt like it took a day. When we got there, a young woman with black hair was waiting for us. For no apparent reason, we all started laughing and goofing off. Everyone had big, joyful smiles. Then the woman led me to the edge of the hill, facing the sun, and had me sit down to watch. She said, "The best part is almost here." But just as the sun looked like it might set, I heard and felt a booming, yet calming, voice surrounding me say, "It’s not time for you yet." And I closed my eyes. When I opened my eyes again, I was being loaded into an ambulance and wracked with terrible pain. I couldn’t move, so I started crying. A shocked EMT shouted, "He’s alive!" One hour and forty-five minutes had passed since I went under the water.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Accident, Drowning, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I felt like I had more reason and control over myself than before, like I knew all the answers to all my questions.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Right as the booming voice came in.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual, It felt like I had spent years playing with these other people. When I came back to Earth, I felt much older.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Some parts of my vision were blurry or out of focus. Others were very detailed.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I couldn't hear the water, animals, or bugs. But I could hear the other people and the air blowing by.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, It was lined with striped blue and silver, but the tunnel was transparent.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, It was white and yet I could stare at it with no issues.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It looked like a valley with a few large hills and a tree, but the sky made no sense.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt pure happiness, and a love that I cannot describe in words
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others, Yes, but I didn't have a need for it, as I had no problems.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: I found it very hard to remember anything from my life itself.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future, After this event, I started dreaming of future events. I do not speak of it.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, Yes, the creek crossing. I wanted to explore it, but the kids begged me to wait just a while longer.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, The meadow place was unexpected, but the part where it was hard to remember Earth was expected.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I heard a voice I could not identify, The voice was booming, meaning it came from everywhere, even from inside of me. I did not feel fear of it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain, I have no idea who it was that I saw. They did not tell me their names nor did I ask.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Uncertain, I seem to have some purpose, but I'm still trying to figure out what that might be. I can only sense that I do have one.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, We need to stop cursing each other. I do not mean cuss words.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, Others were speaking, but I can't remember what was said.
Yes, It exists in everyone and everything. When other people are fully connected with themselves, you can feel it coming from them.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I felt much older than those around me afterward. It has made it very hard to relate with others my age.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I can't connect with other people unless they also believe.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, It's heavy in a sense.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have dreams in my sleep that happen later in my life exactly as I dream them. The furthest so far has been 10 years before.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I heard another story of a little girl who passed briefly, and it was way too close to mine to be ignored.
